sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Technology stands alone as the market's sole all-green pillar with a dominant 0.967 momentum score, while broader market participation remains narrow with only 1 of 11 sectors showing positive returns across all timeframes.

Leadership is tightly concentrated at the top. Technology (momentum 0.967, rank 2) and Energy (momentum 0.800, rank 1) are maintaining decisive command over sector rankings. Meanwhile, slight upward rotation emerged in Industrials (moving to rank 4, momentum 0.633) and Communication Services (advancing to rank 8, momentum 0.583), each improving by one spot over the last five sessions.

Defensive and rate-sensitive sectors continue to fade. Healthcare slipped to rank 5 (momentum 0.583) and Real Estate fell to rank 9 with a trailing momentum score of 0.133. Consumer Cyclical sits at the bottom of the board at rank 11 with weak 0.283 momentum, highlighting a lack of broad-based cyclical participation.

## Strength
- Technology is the single group (1 of 11) qualifying as all-green across week, month, quarter, half, and YTD frames.
- Technology has sustained top-3 status across 1-, 3-, and 6-month ranks, supported by a 0.967 momentum score.
- Energy retains the top year-to-date position at rank 1 with strong 0.800 momentum.

## Movers & Momentum
- Industrials gained +1 spot over five sessions to reach rank 4 with a 0.633 momentum score.
- Communication Services also climbed +1 spot over five sessions, moving to rank 8 with 0.583 momentum.
- Healthcare and Real Estate were the primary decliners, each dropping -1 spot over five sessions to rank 5 and rank 9, respectively.
- Real Estate (0.133 momentum), Utilities (0.217 momentum, rank 10), and Consumer Cyclical (0.283 momentum, rank 11) anchor the bottom of the momentum spectrum.

## Divergences
- Extreme momentum dispersion separates market leaders from laggards, spanning from Technology at 0.967 down to Real Estate at 0.133.
- Breadth remains exceptionally thin, with only 1 of 11 sectors registering all-green signals across all measured horizons.
- No valid fragile all-green early-warning signals are present in the current data.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy and tech hardware maintain multi-timeframe dominance, while healthcare and real estate face sharp short-term distribution.

Market leadership remains concentrated, with only 16 of 144 groups qualifying as all-green. Energy and semiconductors continue to anchor the top of the board, led by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (0.992 momentum, YTD rank 2) alongside Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (0.953 momentum) and Semiconductors (0.951 momentum). Core industrial and tech supply chain groups—including Electronics & Computer Distribution and Marine Shipping—show sustained top-36 positioning across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons. 

Short-term rotations show defensive and industrial buyers stepping into Medical Distribution (+19 spots to rank 61) and Aerospace & Defense (+18 spots to rank 72). Conversely, pharma and rate-sensitive segments are deteriorating quickly: Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic tumbled 19 spots (rank 100), Pharmaceutical Retailers shed 18 spots (rank 123), and residential real estate groups remain locked near the bottom of momentum rankings.

## Strength
* **Dominant Leaders:** Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing leads all industries with a 0.992 momentum score (rank 2 YTD), followed closely by Electronics & Computer Distribution (0.977 momentum, rank 3 YTD).
* **Semiconductor Complex:** Semiconductor Equipment & Materials (0.953 momentum, rank 4 YTD) and Semiconductors (0.951 momentum, rank 8 YTD) remain all-green across all evaluated periods.
* **Sustained Multimonth Power:** Communication Equipment (0.935 momentum), Marine Shipping (0.93 momentum), Scientific & Technical Instruments (0.91 momentum), and Copper hold sustained top-36 ranks over 1-, 3-, and 6-month spans.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top 5-Day Climbers:** Medical Distribution surged 19 spots (rank 61, 0.72 momentum), Aerospace & Defense rose 18 spots (rank 72, 0.61 momentum), and Utilities - Regulated Water gained 18 spots (rank 53, 0.68 momentum).
* **Top 5-Day Decliners:** Drug Manufacturers - Specialty & Generic plummeted 19 spots (rank 100, 0.40 momentum), Pharmaceutical Retailers dropped 18 spots (rank 123, 0.40 momentum), and REIT - Healthcare Facilities lost 13 spots (rank 42, 0.46 momentum).
* **Deep Momentum Laggards:** Advertising Agencies sits at the absolute bottom with 0.037 momentum (YTD rank 144), followed by REIT - Mortgage (0.049 momentum, YTD rank 131) and Gambling (0.052 momentum, YTD rank 143).

## Divergences
* **Momentum Fading:** High-momentum groups showing near-term rank loss include Steel (0.80 momentum, -3 spots in 5d), Farm & Heavy Construction Machinery (0.78 momentum, -3 spots in 5d), and Consumer Electronics (0.75 momentum, -4 spots in 5d).
* **Early Reversals:** Low-momentum groups exhibiting sharp short-term rank jumps include Uranium (+7 spots, 0.26 momentum), Luxury Goods (+12 spots, 0.42 momentum), and Leisure (+8 spots, 0.42 momentum).
